_help_engine: mini = built-in local GraphRAG (runs anywhere, no install). microsoft = real Microsoft GraphRAG CLI (pip install graphrag, then index ms_graphrag). If microsoft is not installed or not indexed, the demo falls back to mini.
_help_llm: offline = no LLM; template answers. ollama = free local LLM (first run: ollama run qwen2.5:1.5b). claude = Anthropic API (pip install anthropic + API key). If the chosen LLM is unavailable, the demo falls back to offline.
